_comment: A7 compliance rules (S3 T8). Data, not code: app/compliance/filter.py reads this file once. The build plan says rules.yaml; PyYAML is not installed, so JSON. Matching is case-insensitive and runs on the text with HTML tags removed and entities decoded. kind: phrase (literal phrases, word boundaries, any whitespace between words, straight or curly apostrophes, hyphen or space in hyphenated words) | regex | requires (text must contain `pattern`). action: block | flag | rewrite (rewrite only for requires: appends `replacement`). allow: phrases; a match that overlaps one is harmless. unless: a regex; when it occurs anywhere in the text the rule does not fire. reported_action: the action for a match inside quotation marks or after a reporting verb (said, told, according to), i.e. someone else's words being reported. Tokens: {{disclaimer}} is the text of config/disclaimer.md; {{ticker}} (regex rules only) is any symbol of the ticker universe passed to check() (default: the app's stock universe), case-insensitive.

rules.description: Promotional phrases: promises of gains or of safety.
Direct buy/sell advice to the reader ("you should buy", "I'd buy AAPL", "I recommend buying", "Buy AAPL now!").
Personalized instructions tied to the reader's own holdings ("sell your AAPL", "your portfolio should", "you need to buy").
Pressure to act quickly. Flagged, not blocked: "act now" is also ordinary wording ("act now on the tax change").
Performance mentions must reference ledger data: allowed only when the text carries a {{ledger:...}} reference (rendered by T12). Flag, not block, until T12 exists.
The research disclaimer (config/disclaimer.md) must be present; if it is missing it is appended (inside <body> for HTML). The only rewrite.
